title: Define shared TypeScript types for all section content and site types
description: Create src/types/site.ts with all TypeScript interfaces and types needed for the site data model: BusinessInfo, SiteConfig, SiteSection, and content types for all 21 section types. These types are shared between the admin app, the AI pipeline, and the exported sites.
acceptanceCriteria: Content types exist for all 21 section types (HeroContent, ServicesContent, etc.)
Each content type is the union of all fields any variant of that type needs
Optional fields are typed as `field?: type`
`SiteSection` has: id (string), type (SectionType), variant (string), visible (boolean), content (typed per section)
Types are importable without TypeScript errors

steps.description: Define SectionType enum and SiteSection interface
Define content types for hero, services, about, trust_indicators, testimonials, process
steps.details: Define: `HeroContent` (headline, subheadline, ctaText, ctaHref, imageUrl, badgeText?), `ServicesContent` (items: Array<{title, description, icon?}>), `AboutContent` (headline, body, imageUrl?, stats?: Array<{value, label}>), `TrustIndicatorsContent` (items: Array<{icon?, label, value}>), `TestimonialsContent` (items: Array<{quote, author, role?, rating?}>), `ProcessContent` (headline, steps: Array<{number, title, description}>).

steps.description: Define content types for service_area, gallery, faq, cta_banner, contact
steps.details: Define: `ServiceAreaContent` (headline, areas: string[], mapEmbedUrl?), `GalleryContent` (headline, images: Array<{url, alt, caption?}>), `FaqContent` (headline, items: Array<{question, answer}>), `CtaBannerContent` (headline, subheadline?, ctaText, ctaHref), `ContactContent` (headline, showForm: boolean, showMap?: boolean).

steps.description: Define content types for the remaining 11 section types
steps.details: Define: `PricingContent` (headline, tiers: Array<{name, price, features: string[], highlighted?}>), `TeamContent` (headline, members: Array<{name, role, bio?, imageUrl?}>), `CertificationsContent` (headline, items: Array<{name, imageUrl?, year?}>), `EmergencyContent` (headline, phone, availability, services?: string[]), `BenefitsContent` (headline, items: Array<{title, description, icon?}>), `ComparisonContent` (headline, columns: Array<{label, features: string[]}>), `BrandsContent` (headline?, brands: Array<{name, logoUrl?}>), `BlogPreviewContent` (headline, posts: Array<{title, excerpt, date, imageUrl?}>), `VideoContent` (headline, videoUrl, poster?), `GuaranteeContent` (headline, body, badgeText?).

technicalNotes: These types serve as the single source of truth for the AI pipeline's Zod schemas (TASK-42), component props, and the export config.
Every content type field that is used by at least one variant must be included. Optional fields (used by some variants but not others) are typed as `field?: type`.
This file should be co-located in both `src/types/site.ts` (admin app) and `site-template/src/types/site.ts` (exported sites) — or symlinked/copied at export time.
